scope.summary: Repair the rotted feature-gated live Oracle test target (live_oracle.rs K3 migrated to resolve_plan_table + unique PlanStatementId per EXPLAIN, assertions unchanged) and add a per-push CI compile gate for env-gated live test targets so they cannot rot silently again.
out_of_scope: Running the full live_oracle suite in CI (needs an Oracle service); the CI gate is compile-only by design.

entry_points.name: live K3 (orchestrator re-execution)
entry_points.trace: At c16a49ad, ORACLEMCP_LIVE_XE=1 as least-privilege E2E_ORACLE on free23: live_explain_plan_cost_estimate_orders_full_scan_above_pk_lookup 1 passed; full_scan(cost=19, card=5000) above pk_lookup(cost=2, card=1). Assignee also reported XE21/XE18 as SYSTEM passing.
